strings.210-ФЗ, статья 11.2, часть 6. Срок рассм: Law No. 210-ФЗ, Article 11.2, part 6. The complaint consideration period; sending the reasoned reply has a separate deadline.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.В исходной истории ошибка присутствовала: In the original scenario, the error existed when the document was issued. Here the information changed later, so the substantive outcome changes but the complaint's subject-specific deadline remains.
strings.В учебных условиях отдельный порядок вне: The training scenario has a separate amendment procedure; charges must be checked under it, not invented on the spot.
strings.Вы работаете в подразделении, обеспечива: You work in the unit supporting consideration of a complaint by the proper recipient. Prepare materials and a draft reasoned decision; do not assume the powers of the body providing the service. The case documents determine the specific recipient. This training service applies Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ; no other special federal procedure is specified.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.

strings.Досудебная жалоба по главе 2.1 закона №: Pre-trial complaint under Chapter 2.1 of Law No. 210-ФЗ
strings.Единый тридцатидневный порядок независим: A uniform thirty-day procedure regardless of subject matter
strings.Если требование не подтвердилось, жалобу: If the demand is unsubstantiated, the complaint need not be registered.
strings.Жалоба зарегистрирована как обжалование: The complaint is registered as an appeal against refusal to correct an alleged error. It must be considered under that subject matter even if examination reveals changed circumstances rather than a typo.
strings.Задним числом объявить исходный документ: Retrospectively declare the original document erroneous.
strings.Изменить исходную запись задним числом,: Alter the original record retrospectively, concealing the changed circumstances
strings.Какая фамилия была в документах при выда: Which surname was in the documents when the result was issued?
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Когда изменились сведения относительно в: When did the information change relative to issuance?
When did the information change relative to issuance? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения жалобы на отка: Final day for reviewing the complaint against refusal to correct
strings.Любое несовпадение сегодня доказывает ош: Any discrepancy today proves an error at the time of original issuance.
strings.Любое новое несоответствие считать после: Treat every new discrepancy as a consequence of the surname change.
strings.Менять срок после того, как доводы заяви: Change the deadline after the applicant's arguments fail to be confirmed.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью, устанавливающую общий по: Find the article establishing the general procedure for submitting and reviewing pre-trial complaints concerning service provision.
strings.Не выдумываем стоимость и новую процедур: Do not invent fees or a new procedure.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Не рассматривать жалобу из-за неподтверж: Do not consider the complaint because the typo is unconfirmed.
strings.Немедленное удовлетворение любого требов: Immediate satisfaction of every demand without verification
strings.Новое состояние данных не доказывает пре: The current data do not prove an earlier typo; consider the complaint and explain the proper update procedure.
strings.Обжалую отказ исправить документ как оши: I am appealing the refusal to correct the document as erroneous.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Отделить подтверждённую первоначальную о: Separate the confirmed original date-of-birth error from the later surname change and apply the corresponding procedures.
strings.Отказать в регистрации жалобы только из-: Refuse to register a complaint solely because its arguments are disputed
strings.Отказаться читать исходные документы пос: Refuse to read the original documents after the first negative finding.
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Подготовить мотивированное решение по жа: Prepare a reasoned complaint decision and explain the separate data-amendment procedure, without promising to correct a nonexistent typo.
strings.Подготовить мотивированный вывод по заре: Prepare a reasoned conclusion on the registered complaint
strings.Помощник: «Если опечатки нет, жалоба на: Assistant: 'If there is no typo, a complaint about refusal to correct it no longer has a five-day deadline.'
strings.После выдачи результата, в свидетельстве: After the result was issued; the certificate bears a later date.
strings.После получения документа я сменил фамил: I changed my surname after receiving the document. I asked for the old surname to be corrected as a typo, but the body refused. I think they should simply replace one line for free.
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Предмет жалобы определяет срок даже при: The complaint's subject determines the deadline even if the demand is unfounded.
strings.Проверить совпадение сведений на момент: Check whether the information matched when the original result was issued
strings.Проверить, что заявителю объяснили разли: Check that the applicant was told how the procedures differ and was not asked for unnecessary documents
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Разъяснить доступный порядок обновления: Explain the available update and appeal procedures without arbitrary charges
strings.Рассмотреть жалобу в пятидневном рабочем: Consider the complaint within five working days and explain how to update the data, without acknowledging a nonexistent original error.

Review the complaint within five working days and explain how to update the data, without acknowledging an original error that did not exist. In the original story, the error was present when the result was issued. Here, the information changed later, so the substantive outcome changes, but the subject-specific complaint period remains.
strings.Сведения изменились после выдачи; новое: The information changed after issuance; the current data do not prove an earlier typo. Consider the complaint and explain the proper update procedure.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Свидетельство об изменении фамилии имеет: The surname-change certificate is dated later than the service result. The original information matched. This timeline distinguishes changed data from an error, but does not remove the duty to consider a complaint about refusal to correct an alleged typo.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Сопоставить даты выдачи и изменения фами: Compare the issue date and the surname-change date
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Срок определяется предметом обжалования,: The deadline is determined by the subject of the appeal; whether the demand is ultimately justified is established during consideration.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Та же, что указана в результате. Все зап: The same as in the result. All records matched at that time.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation

The scenario provides a separate procedure for updating information; an error by the issuing body in the original record is not established.
strings.Учебное продолжение. При обращении за об: Training follow-up. During the update request, the operator discovered that the original result also had an incorrect date of birth; that date had not changed.
